methodology.selection: Global public preset pinned before RNG. One independent ticket before symbols grants4 actual free spins, at most once per charged round. Paid grants may start a disclosed promotional bonus; bought grants extend its active tier.
methodology.bounds: All original nominal pay tables, stake/buy/feature prices,25/30x ordinary budgets, per-free-spin budgets,40x−1AR actual cap,5% bonus minimum and guard behavior retained.
methodology.calibration: Fresh calibration xoshiro128** endpoint means; ticket weight from a convex mixture, not result inspection or payout scaling.
methodology.holdout: Independent disjoint SHA256-seeded sfc32. At least20000 transactions per preset/offer/stake; ordinary paid stake50 uses100000. Any engine error aborts. Full purchase/feature price is charged once; all native/free/promotional spins counted.
methodology.confidence: Normal95% Monte Carlo interval around full-round gross return. Targets50/55/60 are approximate expectations, not exact certified RTP or promised player results.
methodology.security: LocalDEMO profile capability only. Future real-currency selection and authorization must be server authoritative; no account/balance/history inputs.
methodology.default50: Calls frozen core directly, consuming no extra RNG.

rareTailProof.boundType: Exact rational union upper bounds for generated attempts; not exact hard-cap frequencies or accepted-round guarantees.
assumptions: The first independent profile lottery is resolved before symbols or House bonus-selection tiles.
Paid-launch ordinary wilds are not carried into the first sticky free spin.
Paid promotional gifts start four sticky/luck FS, or extend an already awarded natural tier.
House has no retrigger; the same body-budget legendary suppression applies.
LeXof collection eligibility precedes independent reward draws; fixed pots are not fresh clovers.
Spin/collection guards reject whole attempts without silently rerolling.
limitations: Finite simulation alone cannot establish billion-scale rarity.
Conditional bounds among accepted attempts would also require an acceptance-probability bound.
Public profile presets increase House upper-tail bounds; base-profile rarity must not be presented as universal.
Local browserDEMO reserve is not an authoritative real-payment ledger.
